title: docs(changelog): amend two released 18.5.0 entries (durable http fallback, OpenAPI connector parameters)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #33896

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：修正 18.5.0 已发布 CHANGELOG 里两条说明（3 个文件，+7/-1）：持久化 http 节点无发件箱回退与发件箱的差异；OpenAPI 连接器用户如何声明被拒的参数。
- 为什么改：原句称回退路径与发件箱发送同样的正文和签名，只对对象正文成立；OpenAPI 连接器用户缺少修复路径。按 AGENTS.md 规则，已发布条目的事实错误在原条目上就地修正。
- 风险与回滚：纯文字，不发布代码；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/CHANGELOG.md`（两处改动都在其中）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -c "OpenAPI connector's action declares" -- '*CHANGELOG.md'` 预期 3 个文件各 1 处。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（本 PR 不带 changeset，由区域席位挂 `skip-changeset` 标签）。

## What changes

`packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` is release-owned; AGENTS.md (Documentation Guardrails) routes a factual error in a released entry to an amendment of that entry in a dedicated docs-only PR. This is that PR. Both corrections were taken out of PR #33886 because the changesets they corrected were consumed by the 18.5.0 release while it was open.

- (a) `packages/services/service-automation/CHANGELOG.md`, 18.5.0 entry `b937b75` (durable `http` node, no `method`): the closing claim "both paths send it, with the same body and signature the outbox would deliver" now holds only for an object body, and the entry names the three places the no-outbox fallback still differs from the outbox: no body, a string body, and the `Content-Type` header.
- (b) The 18.5.0 entry `89defde` (`connector_action` refuses an undeclared input key) gains one paragraph for OpenAPI connector users after the Slack paragraph, in each of the three CHANGELOGs that carry it: `packages/connectors/connector-openapi`, `packages/services/service-automation`, `packages/spec`.

Text is the replacement given in the card, verbatim; every fact it states was checked against `origin/main` at `64807a9c` before editing (see Verification). No source, no changeset: the diff publishes nothing until the next release republishes the tarballs, so it takes `skip-changeset`, which the area seat applies.

## Acceptance notes

1. Other CHANGELOGs carrying the entry: `git grep` for the Slack paragraph's first sentence over every `CHANGELOG.md` at `64807a9c` finds exactly the three edited here (`ui/` and the root CHANGELOG included in the search).

## Verification

<details><summary>Facts behind the wording, at origin/main 64807a9c</summary>

- `packages/apps/connector-stripe/openapi/stripe.openapi.json` (8 operations) and `packages/apps/connector-docusign/openapi/docusign-esignature.openapi.json` (3 operations): 0 header parameters (path-level, operation-level and `components.parameters`), 0 `$ref` parameters. Every operation declares path or query parameters, so each generated action's `inputSchema` lists `properties` and an undeclared `header` key is refused on every action.
- `packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts`: `IGNORED_HEADER_PARAMETERS = new Set(['accept', 'content-type', 'authorization'])`, skipped by `buildInputSchema`; a declared header parameter lands in the `header` section with its `schema` and is sent by `serializeHeaders`; path-level parameters are merged into each operation.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts` fallback: `requestBody = body != null ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined`, signed as `requestBody ?? ''`, headers are the authored ones only. Outbox: enqueued with `payload: body ?? {}`; `deliveryBody()` in `service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts` sends a string verbatim and JSON-serialises anything else, signed over the same bytes at enqueue; `sendOnce` sets `Content-Type: application/json`.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `1ba5091f`: 58 commands. 54 exited 0. 4 exited 3 (NOT MEASURED, prerequisite: they read package `dist/` and this docs-only worktree has no build): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`; CI runs them on a built tree. `--ran` reconciliation: 58 derived, 58 run, 0 unrun. After merging `origin/main` (head `835919e9`) the gates that read CHANGELOG or release text were re-run, all exit 0: `check-release-section-coverage --strict`, `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-affected-docs`, `check:doc-authoring`. None refuses an amended released entry.
</details>
